Question Choices: Select the pair of segments that appears perpendicular in the diagram: ~~Dark-blue-vertical-and-red-horizontal | Green-diagonal-and-red-horizontal | Yellow-vertical-and-red-vertical~~
Hints: Intersecting lines cross. Perpendicular lines are the special case meeting at 90 degrees.
Solution: The blue vertical and red horizontal segments meet at a 90-degree angle. The diagonal/horizontal pair is not 90 degrees and the two vertical segments are parallel.

Question Choices: This is the standard tic-tac-toe board. How many pairs of perpendicular lines are drawn to make the board?
Hints: Count pairs within each parallel direction; count each horizontal-vertical pair for right-angle intersections.
Solution: Each of the two vertical lines is perpendicular to each of the two horizontal lines:2 x 2=4 pairs.

Question Choices: Select. Line A crosses Line B at a 90-degree angle. Which word best describes them?: ~~Parallel | Intersecting | Perpendicular~~
Hints: Intersecting lines cross. Perpendicular lines are the special case meeting at 90 degrees.
Solution: A 90-degree intersection is perpendicular. Intersecting is also true, but perpendicular is the more specific offered description.

Question Choices: Select. If you extend the sides of the triangle shown, will they ever be parallel? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Parallel lines lie in a plane and keep the same distance apart; they never meet.
Solution: Every pair of triangle sides shares a vertex, so their extended supporting lines intersect. No pair can be parallel.

Question Choices: Fill: The steps of the ladder are ________ to each other. (Parallel or Perpendicular)
Hints: Parallel lines lie in a plane and keep the same distance apart; they never meet.
Solution: The depicted ladder rungs run in the same horizontal direction at different heights. Their supporting lines never meet, so the rungs are parallel.
